title: lichen-rpl address_assignment: authenticated_identity_derives_wire_eui test red post-AddrForKey
description: Observed on beads-worker-7 @ b3626a253c (worker7 sync), isolated target dir: cargo test -p lichen-rpl --lib — 252 passed, 1 failed: address_assignment::tests::authenticated_identity_derives_wire_eui_from_key_not_native_origin_bytes (address_assignment.rs:1346). Test name says 'not_native_origin_bytes' — likely pins the rejected SHA-512 native origin derivation for the EUI-64 wire mapping. Same post-AddrForKey expectation-rot family as kd0p (lichen-gateway, fixed) and this round's rubw. Not caused by rubw (zero Rust changes in that diff). FIX: pin expectation to upstream AddrForKey-derived bytes per the pinned yggdrasil_address.json oracle; check eui64_from_authenticated_identity's actual profile first — if the FUNCTION is still native while siblings moved to upstream, the function (not the test) is the bug.
close_reason: No-repro on current main: the reported failure (address_assignment::tests::authenticated_identity_derives_wire_eui_from_key_not_native_origin_bytes, address_assignment.rs:1346) was observed on beads-worker-7 @ b3626a253c BEFORE the i72x.2 migration merged. On main, 5c9f7ef657 (feat(rust): migrate AddrForKey/SubnetForKey to upstream Yggdrasil) already migrated eui64_from_authenticated_identity (address_assignment.rs:113-125) — it now validates origin == ygg_addr_from_pubkey(pubkey) at :117 and derives the wire EUI from iid_from_pubkey_bytes, NOT from origin address bytes; the test already asserts the upstream behavior (key-derived, assert_ne vs the origin's bit-packed low half at :1349, rejects 0x03 non-native and low-order pubkey). Verify on main (CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/mark/Cache/cargo-target): cargo test -p lichen-rpl --lib = 253 passed, 0 failed; the named test is green. No code change needed; closing as already-fixed-on-main. No files touched, no review passes applicable.
